title: Gate multi-file grading benchmarks out of standard mode

scope.primary_deliverable: Mode-compatibility gate: benchmarks with grade_entrypoint set are agent-mode-only — excluded from standard-mode scheduling, short-circuited with a structured skip (error_category skipped_mode_incompatible + Validity ReasonModeIncompatible) at dispatch time, and excluded from every downstream aggregate via the existing FilterValidResults machinery.
out_of_scope: building real multi-file standard-mode support (inline InputFiles, splice into SolutionFiles, run GradeEntrypoint in standard mode)
independently re-verifying docx_reimplement per-model failure causes
auditing other benchmarks for similar prompt/execution mismatches
changes to ShouldExcludeFromCapability or the ShouldExcludeFromCapability switch surface
a check_benchmark.sh / ailang doctor benchmarks lint rule (design Future Work)
retroactively editing historical eval result rows

milestones.title: Add RequiresAgentWorkspace() predicate and ReasonModeIncompatible validity reason
acceptance_criteria: Add func (s *BenchmarkSpec) RequiresAgentWorkspace() bool { return s.GradeEntrypoint != "" } co-located with the GradeEntrypoint/SolutionFiles fields (spec.go:45-54).
Extend the GradeEntrypoint doc comment to state the mode-compatibility rule explicitly: grade_entrypoint implies agent-mode-only (design Risks mitigation for future benchmark authors).

Add ReasonModeIncompatible = "mode_incompatible" to the Reason constants in internal/eval_harness/validity.go alongside ReasonCanaryFailed/ReasonZeroFiles/etc., with a doc comment in the file's established style.
spec_test.go covers RequiresAgentWorkspace() true iff GradeEntrypoint != "" (both set and unset cases; the two real benchmark specs qualify via V10).
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./internal/eval_harness/ passing.

milestones.title: Dispatch-time guard in runSingleBenchmark with zero-provider-calls test
acceptance_criteria: In runSingleBenchmark (eval_benchmark.go:31), add an early standard-mode check after spec load and before the standard-mode chain-stage setup (:87): when agentConfig == nil and spec.RequiresAgentWorkspace(), short-circuit before any provider dispatch (~15 LOC per design).

The skip result carries BOTH error_category = "skipped_mode_incompatible" (human/log readability) AND Validity: eval_harness.MarkInvalid(eval_harness.ReasonModeIncompatible) (machine aggregation exclusion) — design component 3.
The guard is standard-mode-only by construction: the agent branch already returned at :83-84, so agent-mode behavior is untouched.

Create cmd/ailang/eval_benchmark_test.go (new file — none exists today): direct runSingleBenchmark call against markdown_reimplement in standard mode with a mocked/counted provider transport (follow the in-package httptest precedent from configdriven_*_test.go); assert the skip result shape and a zero AI provider call count.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./cmd/ailang/ passing.

milestones.title: Exclude agent-workspace-only benchmarks from standard-mode auto-discovery
acceptance_criteria: Filter out RequiresAgentWorkspace() benchmarks from the standard-mode auto-discovery result (design component 2, ~15-30 LOC): filter at the eval_suite.go:302 call site (evalMode in scope there) or gate inside discoverBenchmarks() — the design allows either; the call-site filter is the smaller diff.
Agent-mode scheduling untouched: agent mode never routes through discoverBenchmarks (explicit --benchmarks required, eval_suite.go:288-292); the explicit-list path must remain unfiltered.

CLI verification: ailang eval-suite --dry-run --tier frontier (standard) no longer lists docx_reimplement/markdown_reimplement in the Benchmarks: line; ailang eval-suite --dry-run --agent --benchmarks docx_reimplement,markdown_reimplement still plans both.

Executor note (V12, no scope change): the --benchmarks-by-confidence path (eval_confidence.go:33, feeds benchmarkList at eval_suite.go:286) is outside design component 2; any such dispatch is caught by M2's dispatch-time guard per the design's defense-in-depth. Record observed behavior; add no second scheduler filter without controller approval.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./cmd/ailang/ passing.

milestones.title: Prove the skip row is excluded from every aggregate; real-data re-run
acceptance_criteria: Extend validity_filter_test.go: a row with Validity.Valid == false and Reason == ReasonModeIncompatible is dropped by FilterValidResults (validity_filter.go:26).

Confirm by reading the load path (verification only, no production edits): eval_elo.go:122 loads via eval_analysis.LoadResults → FilterValidResults, so fitLang (eval_elo.go:254) never sees the skip row; confidence-gating ratings are fit from the already-filtered set.
ShouldExcludeFromCapability remains untouched — a Valid:false row is filtered upstream of it (design component 4 / Verification Log round 3).

Historical result rows are never retroactively edited: old rows keep their historical error_category with no Validity field (absent = valid per IsValid()'s doc comment); only new runs use the skip path.

Manual (design's manual-testing item): re-run markdown_reimplement/docx_reimplement in standard mode post-fix — or confirm on the next scheduled run — and record that they appear absent/labelled-skipped, not as compile/runtime failures.
End the milestone with go build ./... and go test ./internal/eval_analysis/ ./internal/eval_harness/ passing.

milestones.title: Document the mode-compatibility rule, changelog note, final gates
acceptance_criteria: Document the rule in ONE author-facing location (design Success Criterion 6 says 'or'): design_docs/PROGRAM.md or docs/docs/guides/evaluation/harness-setup.md — a benchmark setting grade_entrypoint is agent-mode-only and is excluded from standard-mode scheduling.

Add the release note in changelogs/v0.32-current.md: pre-fix standard-mode data for markdown_reimplement/docx_reimplement should be treated as unreliable per the design doc (design Risks mitigation). Do NOT edit root CHANGELOG.md — it is index-only under the make check-changelog CI gate (V16).
Final diff contains only the approved file list; git diff --name-only matches the allowed_paths table in the plan.
All final gates pass from this worktree: go build ./..., go test ./..., make fmt-check, make lint, make check-boundaries, make check-file-sizes.
No changes to internal/eval_harness/runner.go, internal/eval_harness/agent_validation.go, internal/eval_analysis/validity_filter.go, benchmarks/, or eval_results/.

final_gates: git diff --name-only matches the approved file list
